d: Michigan Senator-elect Abdul El-Sayed takes aim at Donald Trump during a fiery speech at the Muslim Public Affairs Council (MPAC), declaring, “There's a problem with you!” as he attacks Trump's tariff war with Canada. El-Sayed also slams the administration's Iran war and foreign military spending, arguing that Americans are paying the price through higher gas and grocery bills while healthcare and other essential services remain underfunded. His remarks draw loud cheers from the audience as he vows to fight for working families and put their needs first.
